title: Prepia
description:
Currently working as a Frontend Developer at Prepia, building modern, performant, and accessible web interfaces.
The specifics of the product are under NDA, but the focus is on crafting a polished user experience backed by a clean, scalable component architecture and close collaboration with design and backend teams.

title: Ashkin Studio
description:
Founded and ran Ashkin Studio, a software studio delivering high-performance SaaS products and custom web applications for clients across multiple countries. Managed the full project lifecycle for 10+ production-grade projects, maintaining a 100% completion rate.
Led cross-functional teams of up to four developers, owning requirements gathering, sprint planning, code reviews, and delivery. Standardized reusable component libraries and CI/CD pipelines that reduced time-to-launch and kept quality consistent across the portfolio.
My work bridged business goals and technical execution end to end — from UI/UX strategy and design through scalable, production-ready frontend architecture.

title: Dual SOFT
description:
Worked as a Full-Stack Developer building reactive Angular UI components backed by Spring Boot microservices with PostgreSQL integration.
Engineered an event-driven architecture using Kafka and RabbitMQ, and integrated real-time WebSocket notifications for live updates under heavy concurrent load. Maintained 80%+ test coverage across my assigned modules and conducted regular peer code reviews to uphold code quality.

title: iMET
description:
Built Angular frontend modules and Spring Boot RESTful APIs for an enterprise university platform serving 20,000+ students and 200+ staff.
Architected a modular monorepo serving multiple faculties, with shared modules that kept the system scalable and maintainable as it grew.
Developed an internal analytics platform in Python/Flask that automated KPI reporting across 50,000+ records, reducing aggregation time from days to minutes.
